lobster-dispatching-parallel-agents v1.0.0

- Initial release introducing the parallel agent dispatching pattern.
- Skill guides users to delegate unrelated tasks to focused, isolated agents working concurrently.
- Provides detailed strategies for agent prompt design and task scope.
- Outlines when to use (and when *not* to use) parallel dispatch for maximum effectiveness.
- Includes real-world debugging examples demonstrating parallelization benefits.
